name: SubWF 04C - Human in the Loop Escalation

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_number, customer_id, conversation_id, priority, status, reason, assigned_team, escalation_channel, sla_due_at)
VALUES (
  'TICK-' || floor(random() * 90000 + 10000)::text,
  '{{ ($json.customer && $json.customer.id && $json.customer.id !== "null") ? $json.customer.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  '{{ ($json.conversation && $json.conversation.id && $json.conversation.id !== "null") ? $json.conversation.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.ai_output?.sentiment === 'angry' ? 'urgent' : 'high' }}',
  'open',
  '{{ ($json.customer_message || 'Citizen requested specialist assistance').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'MCIT Citizen Escalations Team',
  '{{ $json.channel || 'webchat' }}',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (CASE WHEN '{{ $json.ai_output?.sentiment }}' = 'angry' THEN INTERVAL '30 minutes' ELSE INTERVAL '2 hours' END)
)
RETURNING ticket_number, priority, status, sla_due_at, created_at;

=INSERT INTO audit_logs (workflow_name, event_type, channel, payload)
VALUES (
  'SubWF 04C - Escalation',
  'hitl_escalated',
  '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel || 'webchat' }}',
  json_build_object(
    'ticket_number', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.ticket_number }}',
    'priority', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.priority }}',
    'sla_due_at', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.sla_due_at }}',
    'customer', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer?.full_name }}',
    'channel_user_id', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel_user_id }}'
  )
);
